description: Search BuyUKeSIM travel/data eSIM plans for a country or regional bundle. The text lists one line per plan: data, validity days, USD price, 5G, top-up, hotspot, local networks (or the number of countries for a multi-country plan), where traffic exits, package code and a buy link that opens checkout on that exact plan. structuredContent (described by outputSchema) repeats this per plan as coverage_countries, networks [{country, name, type}], supports_5g, topup_supported, hotspot_supported (true on every plan), exit_countries and exit_regions, plus retail_price_usd, volume_bytes, duration and buy_url. A feature the supplier does not state is null (unknown), never false: supports_5g null means 5G is not listed, not that it is absent. Pass a 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. GB, US, TR, JP) or a regional bundle code from list_covered_countries (e.g. EU, A1). Omit country to get a short featured list spread across destinations, not a ranking. A code with no plans returns an empty plans array. Data only: no phone number, no SMS (for that see get_uk_number_info).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. GB, US, TR, JP. Optional.

name: search_esim_plans

country.description: Upper-cased location code requested; null for the featured list.

exit_countries.description: Countries internet traffic exits from; null when only a region or nothing is stated.

exit_regions.description: Region names when no country is stated, e.g. Europe; null otherwise.

location_code.description: Country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or one of our regional bundle codes such as EU or A1.

type.description: Radio generation the supplier lists, e.g. 4G or 5G.

supports_5g.description: true when the supplier lists 5G; null means the supplier does not state it (never false).

topup_supported.description: true or false when the supplier states it; null means unknown.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last successful catalogue sync.
